About this game

Easy to Learn • Hard to Master

The Idea is Simple: Koby is a cute little panda floating high into the sky tied to a giant blue balloon. Sharp blocks, hammers, and spinning rings are falling from above to pop his balloon! Move your magic shield to knock every obstacle out of the way and keep Koby rising safely to the top.

🛡️
1. Block with Your Shield

Drag with your finger, move your mouse, or use WASD / Arrow keys to push falling obstacles away from Koby's balloon.

💚
2. Catch Healing Orbs

Touch glowing Green Orbs to heal your balloon (+10% health) and Gold Orbs for +500 bonus points.

🚩
3. Auto-Save Checkpoints

Every wave (100m) automatically saves your checkpoint. If your balloon pops, click Continue to resume right from your wave!

Action Arcade Single Player 3D Graphics Mobile
